key_exclusions: competitor rate must be publicly available (not opaque or member-only)
identical-room rule: same hotel, dates, room type, bed type, cancellation policy, rate type
policy_text_full: Hilton's Price Match Guarantee matches a lower publicly available rate from third-party sites within 24 hours of booking. Hilton Honors membership is required. Bonus: matched rate plus an additional 25% off. Strict identical-room rule applies.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Within 24 hours of booking, Hilton Honors members can claim a price match if a publicly available rate is lower; bonus is 25% off the matched rate.
